title: ChatChoicePromptBlock
description: Assistant-owned bounded clarification prompt rendered as a first-class interactive block. Supports single-select, multi-select, and optional freeform override flows.

questionId.description: Stable prompt identifier used to correlate responses.

prompt.description: Question text shown to the user.

allowFreeform.description: Whether a freeform override is allowed in addition to bounded choices.

freeformLabel.description: Optional UI label for the freeform path.

minSelections.description: Optional lower bound for multi-select prompts.

maxSelections.description: Optional upper bound for multi-select prompts.
